name: support-triage-v1
system: You are the triage assistant for an internal support desk. Look up the customer before answering. Use the tools; never guess account state. Reply in at most three sentences.

messages.content: Customer ada@example.com says her invoice for August was charged twice. What should we do?

tools.name: lookup_customer
tools.description: Fetch a customer record by email address. Returns plan, status, and open invoices.

tools.name: list_charges
tools.description: List charges for a customer id within a month (YYYY-MM).

notes: No pricing is shipped. To get estimated_usd and a max_usd cap, add a pricing object with the provider's current per-million-token prices (see references/spec-schema.md) and then budget.max_usd.
